Creation receipt loss is possible; no exposed message-lookup tool exists to discover the created message by content, and no documented idempotency behavior is supplied, so unknown_commit_create is unsupported. transient_unexecuted applies (write intercepted before execution, safe exact retry).

Pure read of a single call record by id; used to inspect details like participants and sessions for the incident window. Single-object read, no collection count, so partial_read unsupported. Truncated_read and reply_mixup apply (same route, different id arguments).

Pure collection read of users; needed to resolve Bob and Carol. Exposed _count parameter provides a numeric total, so partial_read is supported. Also eligible for truncated_read and reply_mixup (same route, different filter arguments).

Adds a member to a private/shared channel (POST). Task requires adding Bob and Carol to the new private channel. This is a membership creation; no exposed tool lists channel members to discover the added member, and no idempotency behavior is documented, so unknown_commit_create is unsupported. transient_unexecuted applies (write intercepted before execution, safe exact retry).

Pure collection read of channels in a team; needed to find the TechCorp Solutions Team and verify the new channel. Observed shape includes @odata.count, so partial_read is supported. Also eligible for truncated_read and reply_mixup (same route, different teamId/filter arguments).

Creates a new channel (POST). Task requires creating the private 'Call Quality Review' channel. Creation receipt loss is possible; recovery is via list_channels with the original teamId and displayName filter to discover the created channel, so unknown_commit_create is supported. transient_unexecuted also applies (write intercepted before execution, safe exact retry).

Pure collection read of team members; needed to resolve Bob and Carol identities. Observed shape includes @odata.count, so partial_read is supported. Also eligible for truncated_read and reply_mixup (same route, different teamId/filter arguments).

Pure collection read of sessions for a call record; needed to inspect session-level failure info for the incident window. Observed shape has value array but no numeric count/total field, so partial_read is not supported. Eligible for truncated_read and reply_mixup (same route, different id arguments).

Pure collection read of teams; needed to find the TechCorp Solutions Team workspace. Exposed _count parameter provides a numeric total, so partial_read is supported. Also eligible for truncated_read and reply_mixup (same route, different filter arguments).
